## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(scope): …`, `fix: …`) — it becomes the changelog line
- [ ] `just check` passes locally (the same checks as CI)
- [ ] New logic lives in a UI-free crate or a pure function and has tests
- [ ] `PROGRESS.md` updated when a feature lands or a known gap changes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, tests or logs
- [ ] UI change: checked by hand in the app (describe how), screenshots if visual
